name: Measured agent productivity P-007 fixed-cohort HOLD decision
command: plans:get-spec-evidence measured-agent-productivity-2026-09-06 WI-10000336 SPEC-P007-rollout through http://127.0.0.1:3170
summary: The frozen D-010 three-member release cohort reproduces a 0/7/0 committed-outcome distribution, only 2/7 usable immutable claim-to-close latencies, and three estimated-list-price usage samples with no billed-account identity. The P-001 baseline used heterogeneous preselected examples rather than this fixed release population, so causal completion improvement is not established. A deterministic negative control rejects a false matched, balanced, complete-latency rollout claim and produces the required HOLD. Current rollback/guardrail evidence remains green, but no broader rollout, physical acceptance, independent GO, 72-hour canary, or shipment is supported.

assertions.evidence: Decision measured-agent-productivity-2026-09-06#D-010 freezes exactly su-ff731175-6861-4933-b84e-6fe8dd12255a, su-20f9ad02-8a19-40f9-b644-62ea27f7abb7, and su-bdc95e31-f4be-4a87-85c9-c0d2dfcc388c after 2026-09-06T22:56:42.114Z; silent members stay in the denominator and no replacement launch is permitted.

The scoped work-item writer fields terminal_owner + authority + closed_ts return seven committed done rows, distributed [0,7,0] in D-010 member order. Exact ids: WI-10000387, WI-10000439, WI-10000546, WI-10000609, WI-10000634, WI-10000655, WI-10000661; all seven belong to su-20f9ad02-8a19-40f9-b644-62ea27f7abb7.

The seven committed completion records are not seven unqualified wins: WI-10000387 is preparatory-PASS/release-RED, WI-10000634 is an independent RED finding, and later rows include reconciliation and grading-integrity work. The records are independently inspectable, but productive-member yield remains 1/3.

The immutable first_claimed_at writer is migration 1037. Only WI-10000387 and WI-10000634 have claim-start stamps, producing exact claim-to-close values 1,177,391.800 ms and 1,604,619.173 ms (nearest-ms values 1,177,392 and 1,604,619). Five of seven are NULL, so no cohort latency statistic is claimed; worked_by_history is explicitly not used as claim-start.

Exactly three session-attributed usage rows map through adv_sessions to the frozen members: ids 95611, 95662, and 101021. Totals are input=383,657, cache-read=1,927,808, cache-creation=0, output=6,356, estimated list-price USD=1.176160875; all model=gpt-5.6-sol, cost_source=estimated, account_id=NULL. Billed actual cost is unknown, not $1.176160875.

P-001 evidence binding 1137 declares denominator 'three preselected owner/session examples; four exact startup rollouts' spanning independent-review, coding/investigation, and focused completion examples. It is heterogeneous and task-unmatched to D-010's fixed release cohort, so it cannot establish a causal completion-quality lift.

The executed false claim asserted matched250kBaseline=true, improvedVerifiedCompletion=true, balancedMemberContribution=true, completeLatency=true, and broaderRollout=true. The control killed it on baseline-unmatched, terminal-distribution-0-7-0, latency-unknown-5-of-7, and acceptance-chain-absent; output verdict was hold-no-broader-rollout with causalImprovementEstablished=false.

Staging evaluator build 9c9f2fade3 read binding 2422 as server-measured/current across exact source and test file sets, with numeric testRunId 17635323. It anchors the four rollback/guardrail groups 996008d6-30a7-4aed-8cd2-64be7cc46537, 252e252c-c2f1-45b4-bb1b-330d6772cb54, 3cca5d70-6bcb-4a82-9cbc-648e9091d143, and 9c955e4d-2780-4911-af25-e5114edb7295, each previously observed terminal pass/exit 0.

The operational check passes because it detects insufficient causal evidence and preserves the approved policy: 250,000-token member cap, original preload, learning master hold, no replacement population, and no broader rollout. It does not assert that the candidate rollout succeeded.
No physical acceptance, independent GO, actual 72-hour canary, or final shipment record was found or claimed. These remain explicit absent acceptance stages, not silently converted to pass.

comparison.baselineDenominator: three preselected owner/session examples; four exact startup rollouts

queries.fixedCohort: SELECT feature_id,terminal_owner,status,authority,first_claimed_at,admitted_at,closed_ts,payload->'_completionEvidence' AS completion_evidence FROM harness_shared.work_items WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND terminal_owner IN ('su-ff731175-6861-4933-b84e-6fe8dd12255a','su-20f9ad02-8a19-40f9-b644-62ea27f7abb7','su-bdc95e31-f4be-4a87-85c9-c0d2dfcc388c') AND closed_ts >= (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-06T22:56:42.114Z')*1000)::bigint ORDER BY closed_ts,feature_id
queries.fixedMemberSessions: SELECT coord_owner_id,session_id,started_at,ended_at,first_seen_at FROM harness_shared.adv_sessions WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND coord_owner_id IN ('su-ff731175-6861-4933-b84e-6fe8dd12255a','su-20f9ad02-8a19-40f9-b644-62ea27f7abb7','su-bdc95e31-f4be-4a87-85c9-c0d2dfcc388c') ORDER BY coord_owner_id,started_at
queries.fixedMemberUsage: SELECT id,session_id,ts,model,input_tokens,cache_read_tokens,cache_creation_tokens,output_tokens,cost_usd,cost_source,account_id FROM harness_shared.agent_usage_samples WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND session_id IN ('01a078f2-d547-7f80-9aee-cf35fed3449a','01a07f20-a559-7e80-944f-eb527bdd4e6f','01a078f1-612d-7d13-a168-ddc3720f452c') AND ts >= (extract(epoch FROM timestamptz '2026-09-06T22:56:42.114Z')*1000)::bigint ORDER BY session_id,ts

source: Reject matched250kBaseline when comparison.baselineMatched is false.
Reject balancedMemberContribution when any frozen member has terminalCommitted=0.
Reject completeLatency when latency.unknown is greater than zero.
Reject broaderRollout when any acceptance-chain stage is absent.
Pass the detector only when every false claim is rejected and the resulting verdict is hold-no-broader-rollout.
